dataList.name: Bearing of a Salsu
dataList.desc:
At 1 Tầng [Breath], lose 10 HP instead of losing Tầng [Breath] (this effect cannot Stagger this unit and does not drop this unit's HP below 1)

Deal +(missing HP percentage on self / 2) damage on Critical Hit using Kỹ Năng Cơ Bản (tối đa 50%)

dataList.name: A Breath Taken Together
dataList.desc:
When gaining Lượng [Breath] using this unit's own Skills and Coin effects, gán 1 [Breath] on an ally that does not have [Breath] or has the lowest Lượng [Breath] (5 lần mỗi lượt)

Đầu Lượt: If Bamboo-hatted Kim is on the field, nhận 1 [SlashDamageUp] và +2 Tầng [Laceration]

dataList.name: The Last Breath
dataList.desc:
If this unit is defeated, gán 5 [Breath] và +2 Tầng [Breath] on all Blade Lineage allies at the next Turn Start

Đầu Lượt: At 20+ Lượng [Breath], equip "Slash Series" on the leftmost Slot
